simple.meaning: פִּיתוֹן (Pîythôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Pithon , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פִּיתוֹן (H6377) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 8:35, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פִּיתוֹן (H6377) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פִּיתוֹן (H6377) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פִּיתוֹן (Pîythôwn) / H6377 is traced through 1 Chronicles 8:35, 1 Chronicles 9:41 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
